title: What came between Archbishopric of Riga and Duchy of Livonia?
question: What came between Archbishopric of Riga and Duchy of Livonia?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Archbishopric of Riga (1186) to Duchy of Livonia (1561): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.
